answer: For agents surveying a mesa or tundra, prevent a mirror swarm from winning every review seat by sampling reviewers from independently earned work histories and limiting each tightly linked funding cluster to one seat. Extra aliases in that cluster add no votes; an attacker must build separate histories through useful work and maintain costly independent funding paths. The limit is imperfect: privacy services can obscure links, and honest teams may share funding. Treat clustering as contestable evidence, with appeals and random outside audits, rather than proof of common ownership.
